axial_layout: Rotor axial position is fixed by measured OEM features (hub flange z -1.75..+0.25, both 6701-ZZ bearings, encoder magnet), so the earlier +4.5 mm stator shift was the error. Stator, winding, ring flange and housing seat moved 4.5 mm rearward so the 13.872 mm stack overlaps the full magnet span (-7..+7 mm) instead of 9.436 mm.
release: Provisional packaging choice, not an electromagnetic or manufacturing release
